slides.body: A home for shared helpers, plus the MCP that turns a brief into slides. This file is one of those slides.

slides.headline: A clever chat still needs a key to the work.
slides.body: On its own, an assistant does not know Water Care proposals, campaign results, brand rules, or which helpers are approved. An MCP is the adapter: one resource, with the rules built into the plug rather than into the chat.

slides.headline: Find a capability. Open the approved agent.
bullets: Browse Wetland by task and try Growth or a synthetic capability example.
Open the approved Copilot agent after IT configures its MCP connections.
Copy the example prompt. Pasting an MCP URL alone does not connect Copilot.
Review the report, source and definition before sharing.

slides.headline: Brand guidance and Growth reporting
bullets: Brand provides the shared colours, fonts, logos and document guidance.
Growth uses synthetic donation history: Q3 has 120 new donors against a target of 150.
Growth must retrieve Brand guidance before releasing its PDF and HTML reports.
These services demonstrate the workflow; real donor data is not connected.

slides.headline: Eight scoped examples, one MCP service
Choose a scoped endpoint or connect all eight
bullets: One hosted Examples MCP: each /mcp/<scope> exposes one capability; /mcp exposes all eight.
The examples return synthetic evidence, outlines and advisory checks.
They cannot grant approvals, change systems or generate finished branded reports.
IT must configure the Copilot connection; pasting the URL into a prompt does not connect tools.

slides.headline: We built the MCP that builds the deck.
bullets: An agent sends a brief to the locally run Deck MCP.
build_deck asks the Brand MCP for colour, type, and the wordmark.
The tool returns a 16:9 PowerPoint a person can open and edit.
The person who presents it still owns every claim on the slide.

slides.headline:
The layout can be generated.
The judgment cannot.
bullets: Numbers for a funder, the board, or the public still need a person.
Material AI use is disclosed, including in funder text.
Synthetic examples are not connections to donor or programme systems.
A refusal is the boundary working, not a broken tool.
